senses.gloss: (IV)--father of माया. Br. II. 9. ६४.
(V)--an author on architecture. M. २५२. 2.
--a शक्ति created from the heart of नृसिम्ह. M. १७९. ६४.
(II)--a daughter of Adharma. भा. IV. 8. 2.

(IV)--a daughter of Maya;
1: Br. II. 9. ६४.
wife of Bhayam and mother of मृत्यु;
2: वा. १०. ४०.
helpmate of वाराहविष्णु.
3: Br. I. 5. १९.
[page२-689+ २७]
(V)--the essence milked by the Asuras from the cow-earth. M. १०. २१.
(VI)--one of the kingly उपायस्। M. २२२. 2.
(VII)--(वैष्णवी): Atimohini and त्रिगुणात्- maka. Vi. V. २१. 1; ३०. १४-9.

(VIII)--represents the lips of the Vedas,
1: वा. १०४. ७५.
makes different varieties of and varied गुणस् with शीलस्।
2: Ib. १०४. ४१.

(I)--the riding animal of कार्त्तिकेय; several on the हिमालयस्;
1: Br. II. २५. १६, २७; III. १०. ४७. M. १६०. २१. वा. ३६. 2; ५४. १९.
a banner of Skanda presented to वायु.
2: Ib. ७२. ४६.
[page२-636+ ३९]
(II)--a peak on the वराह hill. वा. ४२. ७०.
--बाण with the peacock standard; the breaking of the flag was a sign of impending war. Vi. V. ३३. 3.
--of the Agastya family. M. २०२. 2.
taught to Pradyumna by माया- वती. Vi. V. २७. १४.
--a वानर ja1ti. Br. III. 7. ३१९.
--reference to शिव as a divine Hunter. भा. III. 1. ३८.
--worshipped by a seeker of fortune. भा. II. 3. 3.

--also माया, one of the seven great cities;
1: Br. IV. ४०. ९१.
sacred to कुमारी and to पितृस्.
2: M. १३. ३४; २२. १०.
--the atom of ईश्वर; शान्ख्यस् style प्रकृति for माया. वा. १०१. २१८.

--the form which विष्णु took to vanquish the Asuras under ह्राद who defeated the Gods; he ap- proached the Asuras as a naked mendicant, clean shaven and with a bunch of peacock feathers, performing austeri- [page२-690+ २९] ties in the नर्मदा and led them from the path of the Vedas by calling them Arhats; they left the trodden path and abandoned vedic practices and rites, and decried vedic sacrifices. Vi. III. १७. १४-45; १८. 1-३२.

--Rati in her former birth: when her hus- band was burnt by शिव, she was reborn as the superinten- dent of शम्बर's kitchen. Hearing from नारद that Pradyumna was काम and that he was thrown into sea by शम्बर and swallowed by a fish and was brought to her kitchen, she nursed him lovingly and when he came of age, she spoke the truth and taught him महामाया विद्या with which he killed शम्बर: She took him by air to कृष्ण and was rejoiced to become the daughter-in-law of कृष्ण and रुक्मिणी. भा. X. ५५. 6-३८; Vi. V. २७. 7-१६, २७-30.
--are the Daityas, दानवस् and काद्र- veyas; enjoy life to the utmost; only afraid of Hari's चक्र। भा. V. २४. 8. ११-15.
--a son of Maya and रम्भा. Br. III. 6. २९; वा. ६८. २८.
--belonging to the line of क्रोधवश. Br. III. 8. ७०.
